summary: Accepted the separate critic's supported endpoint-corrected decomposition and integrated the separately reviewed root-authored local-factor refinement S(N)*(1-A(N))>=c/log N, sharp along primorials with constant exp(gamma). The remaining sufficient one-sided signed operator condition is explicit and unproved. Retaining the local-factor product weakens the stronger sufficient maximal reflected-Mobius discrepancy saving from exponent 3+eta to 2+eta; that input is also unproved. The elementary O(N log(N)^3) estimate is four logarithms above the guaranteed margin, a comparison of bounds rather than a claim about actual operator size. Recorded the direct near-cubic lower-sieve parameter below 2 and the specialized FI distribution/bilinear deficits. Preserved frozen originals, source-assurance limits and unknown effective constants. Proposed one distinct bounded next mechanism: an explicit weighted Buchstab switching minorant beginning below exponent 1/4 and subtracting least-factor and semiprime counts, with a positive-margin proof or a checked nonpositive certificate as its output. No unconditional cancellation, original F lower margin, Goldbach proof, breakthrough or novelty claim was obtained.

claims.text: The corrected signed-operator reduction is accepted relative to the inspected unconditional coefficient estimates and ordinary BV, with its moving endpoint, plus sign and fixed parameter ranges preserved.
The separately reviewed local-factor bound S(N)*(1-A(N))>=c/log N is uniform in sufficiently large even N and has sharp order along primorial targets.
The unproved maximal twisted discrepancy condition T2-open with exponent 2+eta is sufficient for the one-sided operator condition and hence sufficiently-large ordinary Goldbach.
The actual pointwise parity-sensitive lower bound, the specialized reflected-prime bilinear input, and any Goldbach proof or demonstrated breakthrough remain unestablished.
